target: Shot A endpoint keyframe, followed by Shot D endpoint keyframe
narrative_job: Establish manual app-by-app work as a physical human burden without explaining the concept through labels, mascots or feature UI; this endpoint must later contrast sharply with the delegated Agent backstage world.
before_state: A real human hand is actively switching between laptop trackpad, phone and physical desk materials; the operating surface is dominant and the friction is visible through behavior.
crossing_state: Not rendered in Shot A. The later transition must physically break the operating plane and change depth/camera relationship rather than add a portal or move cards through the same world.
after_state: Not rendered in Shot A. The later Agent world must remove direct human app interaction and use a materially different spatial grammar.
must_have: tactile material variation across skin, glass, keycaps, paper or metal
motivated practical light and believable contact shadows
photographed close or macro perspective with depth separation
manual friction readable with captions muted
engine_route: Native static image generation only for endpoint exploration after isolated pre-generation challenge passes; no premium video call. If the still cannot clear the photographed-material floor, revise the brief before changing engines.
stop_conditions: prompt contains any blocked AI mascot, dashboard, floating-panel or portal language
manual problem depends on readable text
composition has more than one dominant focal event
prompt describes the future Agent world inside the Shot A endpoint
review challenge is not independently executed
candidate reads as generic office stock imagery rather than a directed shot
exact_prompt: Vertical cinematic close-up, photographed realism. A tired but focused adult at a real desk is caught in one precise manual action: one hand on a laptop trackpad while the other reaches for a phone beside scattered paper notes and a closed folder, with another physical device just outside sharp focus. The frame is intimate and observational, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, realistic skin, glass, keycap, paper and metal textures, motivated warm practical desk light against cooler ambient room light, believable reflections and contact shadows, restrained composition with the hand-device interaction as the single dominant focal event. The burden of switching tools is communicated only by physical behavior and spatial clutter. No explanatory text, no futuristic assistant, no icons, no holograms, no feature UI. Serious commercial-film cinematography, not advertising stock photography, not a technology concept poster.

art_director.notes: Independent Art Director must verify that material realism, lighting logic, lens/scale and one-focal-event composition clear the photographed-image floor rather than reading as polished stock-office imagery.

creative_director.notes: Independent Creative Director must verify that the physical action itself creates a memorable manual-work conflict and future contrast, without explanatory UI or generic technology-ad language.

red_team.notes: Strongest remaining risk is generic stock-office imagery. Independent Red Team must challenge whether the physical action and framing are distinctive enough before generation is authorized.
